# Automatic Notion catalog setup
Call this companion from the backup, or run it manually after editing Setup configuration. Select the Notion credential in Notion setup API. A shared parent page is the only Notion ID required for a new catalog.

Creates a dedicated page, inline Workflows database, 14 typed columns and a restore guide. Reuses the same structure on subsequent runs. An existing data source can be adopted by ID; missing compatible columns are added, conflicting types stop the run. Do not run initial setup concurrently for the same parent and title.
